For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic cyberpunk, the young woman shown in <Picture 1> stands on the rain-wet edge of a towering skyscraper at night, wearing the same black-and-red glowing armored bodysuit, transparent long coat with red neon glyphs, metallic prosthetic arm, and short black hair with electric-blue highlights. The camera holds a static medium-wide shot for a brief beat, then becomes a tracking shot that tilts down with large amplitude at fast speed as she crouches and launches backward into the vertical neon canyon. Wind tears at her coat while she tucks and initiates a clean backward somersault against a backdrop of cascading holographic billboards and streaking aircraft lights. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to a low-angle ground-level shot as she completes the backflip and lands in a three-point crouch on a flooded rooftop, one metallic hand and both boots splashing into the reflective water; a brief shockwave of water and neon reflection ripples outward. [Shot 3] At 00:04.800, the shot switches to a fast tracking shot from behind as she rises and sprints down a narrow alley lined with cyan and magenta neon signs, her coat streaming behind her; she rounds a corner at 00:05.400 and dissolves into the crowd and holographic glare, gone by 00:06.000.

overall_soundscape: High-altitude wind roars and intensifies into a rushing fall, layered with the flutter of a transparent coat and faint mechanical servo whine from the prosthetic arm. A sharp splash and metallic footfall punctuate the landing, followed by rapid wet footsteps echoing down the alley before they cut off.

non_diegetic_music: A dark synthwave bass pulse at a fast tempo, joined by a driving arpeggiator that swells during the fall and drops sharply on impact, then fades with the sprint.
